name: Splendor - Prototype
author: thioritz
description: This is same as Splendor (board game), but made with Unity and primitive shapes. This is my first complete game made with Unity, so I post in here just to showcase that I can make a complete game even with just primitive shapes. All credit belong to the people who make the original Splendor board game, and Unity as my game engine. As for me, I am just an ordinary people. Name is Jurgen Desman Thioritz. Thank you for reading and enjoy. Notes: this is for 2-4 players playing locally.
